cases.name: installed non-interactive entry
cases.purpose: Prove that the installed cosh launcher preserves -c output and exit status.

cases.name: default shell through a real PTY
cases.purpose: Prove that the default installed shell accepts commands and exits cleanly in a real PTY.

cases.name: explicit bash PTY
cases.purpose: Prove explicit bash selection, command boundaries, and post-command usability.

cases.name: explicit zsh PTY
cases.purpose: Prove explicit zsh selection, command boundaries, and post-command usability.

cases.name: OpenSSH login shell
cases.purpose: Prove an OpenSSH login reaches the installed cosh shell through a real PTY.

cases.name: sudo execution and credential cleanup
cases.purpose: Prove the allowlisted sudo path and invalidate cached credentials during cleanup.

cases.name: deterministic core provider workflow
cases.purpose: Prove the installed cosh to cosh-core provider path with a deterministic loopback provider.

cases.name: mixed workload soak
cases.purpose: Detect PTY, child-process, descriptor, latency, and memory degradation over long runs.
